== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Favorable Winds]].
* Favorable Winds also lowers the arrow arc, though less than [[Read the Wind]].
* When used in conjunction with [[Read the Wind]], the bonus damage stacks. Arrow arc reduction and speed increase only stack when Favorable Winds is applied last.

==Trivia==
* [[Archer's Signet]] and [[Favorable Winds]] are the only non-[[bow attack]] or [[preparation]] [[skill]]s that require a bow.
